answer.feedback: Accept the exponential-inhibition rate law in C17. C40 has a slightly better fit score, but its KS and Ki estimates are strongly correlated and cannot be separated by these data.
answer.reasoning: C17 fits within the 95% chi-square limit (114.5 vs 147.7), and every parameter has t > 1 with no reported strongly correlated parameter pairs. C40 does not qualify because KS and Ki are strongly correlated (-0.958). C17 reached its fit from only 1 of 4 starts, which warrants caution, but the stated acceptance criteria are met.
